subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should OpenClaw accept this PR's custom yielding glob walker and yielded bootstrap hook dispatch as the right compatibility tradeoff for fixing the bootstrap-context event-loop stall?
rationale: Code review found no definite patch bug, but the PR deliberately changes glob resolution and runtime scheduling on a session-context hot path where green tests alone do not settle upgrade behavior.

options.title: Accept After Green CI
options.body: Land once the exact head is green or the failed shard is proven unrelated, owning the small glob-parity and hook-interleaving behavior change because it directly addresses the reported stall.

options.title: Require Connected Runtime Proof
options.body: Ask for a live embedded_run or Crabbox trace showing channel keepalives or timers stay responsive through bootstrap-context before merge.

options.title: Narrow Or Split The Patch
options.body: Pause if maintainers want async workspace reads separated from custom glob walking or hook scheduling follow-ups.

recommendation.title: Accept After Green CI
recommendation.body: Land once the exact head is green or the failed shard is proven unrelated, owning the small glob-parity and hook-interleaving behavior change because it directly addresses the reported stall.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across bootstrap helpers, hook contracts, and SDK-boundary compatibility decisions for this path.
